# Kortscore

> Kortscore is a free scorekeeper app for tennis and padel that runs on the watch: one tap per point on the wrist, the phone stays in the bag. Spectators follow a live score ticker through a shareable link without installing anything. Made by swordi.studios, an independent studio in Vienna, Austria.

## What it does

- Scores tennis and padel matches, singles and doubles, with one tap per point on a smartwatch
- Handles the rules: advantage and NoAd scoring, tiebreaks, sets to 4 or 6
- Live score ticker: a link the player shares, spectators open it in any browser, no app or account needed
- Match history (the newest 10 matches are free; the complete history with point-by-point log is part of Kortscore Plus), statistics such as win rate and set record
- Free, no ads, no account. Kortscore Plus is an optional one-time in-app purchase (no subscription) for the complete match history, deeper statistics, the AI coach and automatic backups
- Interface in English and German

## Platforms

iPhone (iOS 18+) with Apple Watch (watchOS 26+), and Android (8.0+) with Wear OS (3+) watches. The iOS app also runs on iPad (iPadOS 18+) and on Macs with Apple silicon (macOS 15+); the Apple Watch pairs only with an iPhone. Runs on every Apple Watch from watchOS 26 (Series 6 and newer, SE 2nd generation and newer, every Ultra) and every Wear OS 3 watch (Samsung Galaxy Watch 4 and newer, every Google Pixel Watch, OnePlus Watch 2/3, TicWatch Pro 5, Xiaomi Watch 2, and others; full list at {{ abs_url('compatible', site.x_default) }}). A three-set match uses about 15 to 25 percent of the watch battery.
